# Function to check gaps 
```{r}
fun_checkgaps <- function(x) {
  # Sort the vector
  sorted_x <- sort(x)
  # Compute the differences between consecutive elements
  gaps <- diff(sorted_x)
  # Check the gap between the last element and the first element, considering the circularity (52 back to 1)
  circular_gap <- (52 - max(sorted_x)) + (min(sorted_x) - 1)
  # Check if any gap is larger than 25, including the circular gap
  any(gaps > 25) || circular_gap > 25
}
```

# Function to read conditional effects 
```{r}
fun_condeffects <- function(ce_effects = ceffects_l[[1]], clu_name = NA, multi = FALSE, pat = "rota") {
  
  # Take out gauss if necessary
  clu_name <- str_remove(clu_name, "_gauss")
  
  # Prepare data 
  dat <- mutate(dat_l[[pat]], pi_vac_week_v1 = round(pi_vac_week_v1, digits = 11)) %>%
    distinct(vac_week_v1, pi_vac_week_v1)
  pref_clu_name <- if(!is.na(clu_name)) paste0(":", clu_name) else ""
  # Create group vector 
  var_vector <- c()
  
  # Prepare clusters if necessary
  if(!is.na(clu_name)) {
    # Create cluster variable 
    ce_effects <- ce_effects %>%
      rename(clu = all_of(clu_name)) %>%
      mutate(clu = as.character(clu))
    # Create df of total values per week
    dat_tot <- dat_l[[pat]] %>%
      rename(clu = all_of(clu_name)) %>%
      mutate(clu = as.character(clu)) %>%
      mutate(pi_vac_week_v1 = round(pi_vac_week_v1, digits = 11)) %>%
      group_by(pi_vac_week_v1, vac_week_v1, clu) %>%
      summarise(tot = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
      group_by(clu) %>%
      mutate(clu_checkgaps = fun_checkgaps(vac_week_v1)) %>%
      ungroup()
    
    # Attach cluster to group vector 
    var_vector <- c(var_vector, "clu")
  } else {
    # Create df of total values per week
    dat_tot <- dat_l[[pat]] %>%
      mutate(pi_vac_week_v1 = round(pi_vac_week_v1, digits = 11)) %>%
      group_by(pi_vac_week_v1, vac_week_v1) %>%
      summarise(tot = n(), .groups = "drop")
  }
  
  if(multi) var_vector <- c(var_vector, "imm_name")
  
  # Obtain estimates 
  ce_effects <- ce_effects %>%
    mutate(pi_vac_week_v1 = round(pi_vac_week_v1, digits = 11)) %>%
    select(pi_vac_week_v1, estimate__, lower__, upper__, all_of(var_vector)) %>%
    left_join(dat, by = join_by(pi_vac_week_v1)) %>%
    left_join(dat_tot) %>%
    mutate(estimate_tot = case_when(is.na(tot) ~ NA, .default = estimate__),
           lower_tot = case_when(is.na(tot) ~ NA, .default = lower__),
           upper_tot = case_when(is.na(tot) ~ NA, .default = upper__))
  
  return(ce_effects)
}
```

# Read conditional effects ======================================================
```{r}
# Select only models base, cs or csi that converged 
df_converged <- filter(rhats, Rhat_cond == TRUE, str_detect(mod, "_cs\\.|_csi_|base")) %>%
  mutate(reg = case_when(str_detect(mod, "reg") ~ sub(".*(reg.*)\\.rds.*", "\\1", mod),
                         str_detect(mod, "base") ~ sub(".*(base.*)\\.rds.*", "\\1", mod))) %>%
  filter(!(reg %in% c("base","base_gauss")) | is.na(reg)) %>%
  mutate(multi = grepl("multi", mod))
  
# Read in the conditional effects
ce_effectsraw_l <- sapply(df_converged$mod, function(x) {
  readRDS(glue("{dirs$ceffects}/ce_{x}"))
}, simplify = FALSE)

# Add data 
ce_effects_l <- lapply(seq_len(length(ce_effectsraw_l)), function(x) {
  df_converged_row <- filter(df_converged, mod == names(ce_effectsraw_l)[[x]])
  fun_condeffects(
    ce_effects = ce_effectsraw_l[[x]],
    clu_name = df_converged_row$reg,
    multi = df_converged_row$multi,
    pat = df_converged_row$pat
  )
})
names(ce_effects_l) <- names(ce_effectsraw_l)
```

# Extract coefficients for the cosinor =============================================================  
```{r}
coef_l <- sapply(df_converged$mod, function(x) {
  readRDS(glue("{dirs$coef}/coef_{x}"))
}, simplify = FALSE)

# Extract coefficients for the cosinor and obtain amplitude and phase
coef_cosine_l <- lapply(coef_l, function(x) rownames_to_column(x$fixed, var = "parameter")) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "mod") %>%
  # Coefficients of the cosinor only 
  filter(str_detect(parameter, "cos|sin")) %>%
  mutate(param = case_when(str_detect(parameter, "cos") ~ "p_cos",
                           str_detect(parameter, "sin") ~ "p_sin")) %>%
  # Attach pathogen and reg 
  left_join(select(df_converged, -Rhat_cond), by = join_by(mod)) %>%
  # Extract the imm_name and clu from the parameter name
  mutate(
    imm_name = str_extract(parameter, "(?<=immvals1anti)[^_]+"),
    clu = str_remove_all(parameter, "reg|_2|_3|_4|_6|cospi_vac_week_v1|sinpi_vac_week_v1|:|immvals1anti|_gauss"),
    clu = case_when(!is.na(imm_name) ~ str_remove_all(clu, imm_name), .default = clu),
    clu = sub("^_", "", clu),
    clu = case_when(
      str_detect(reg, "reg_2") & clu == "" ~ "1_North",
      str_detect(reg, "reg_3|reg_4|reg_6") & clu == "" ~ "1_Temperate",
      !is.na(reg) & clu != "" ~ clu)) %>%
  select(pat, mod, param, reg, clu, imm_name, Estimate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = param, values_from = Estimate) %>%
  # Estimate amplitude and phase
  mutate(
    amp = sqrt((p_cos^2) + (p_sin^2)),
    # Periodic phi in radians
    periodic_phi = case_when(
      p_cos > 0 ~ atan((-1*p_sin)/(p_cos)),
      p_cos < 0 ~ atan((-1*p_sin)/(p_cos)) - pi),
    # Periodic phi in weeks
    periodic_phi_week = 52*(periodic_phi*-1)/(2*pi)) %>%
  # Estimate phi empirically 
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(phi_emp = which(p_cos*cos(2*pi*(1:52)/52) + p_sin*sin(2*pi*(1:52)/52) == 
                           max(p_cos*cos(2*pi*(1:52)/52) + p_sin*sin(2*pi*(1:52)/52)))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Estimate phi 
  mutate(
    phi = case_when(
      periodic_phi_week < 0 ~ periodic_phi_week + 52,
      periodic_phi_week > 0 ~ periodic_phi_week,
      periodic_phi_week == 0 ~ 0),
    phi = case_when(phi > 0 & phi < 1 ~ 52, .default = phi)) %>%
  # Create column for waic over baseline model or not
  mutate(minwaic = !(pat %in% minwaic_df[str_detect(minwaic_df$mod, "base"),]$pat))

saveRDS(coef_cosine_l, glue("{dirs$outputs}/modres_coef_cosine.rds"))
```

# Extract spaghetti conditional effects ============================================================
```{r}
cespa_l <- sapply(df_converged$mod, function(x) {
  readRDS(glue("{dirs$cespa}/cespa_{x}"))
}, simplify = FALSE)

dat_plspa <- bind_rows(cespa_l, .id = "mod") %>%
  # Obtain clu name
  mutate(clu = coalesce(reg_2, reg_3, reg_4, reg_6)) %>%
  # Select only necessary columns
  select(mod, clu, imm_name, sample__, pi_vac_week_v1, estimate__, est_norm) %>%
  # Add pat and reg
  left_join(select(df_converged, -c(Rhat_cond, multi)), by = join_by(mod)) %>%
  select(mod, pat, reg, clu, imm_name, sample__, pi_vac_week_v1, estimate__, est_norm) %>%
  # Extract imm_name and fix pi_week
  mutate(imm_name = str_extract(imm_name, "(?<=immvals1anti).+?(?=\\.)"),
         pi_vac_week_v1 = round(pi_vac_week_v1, digits = 11)) %>%
  # LITTLE CHANGE HERE BECAUSE OF THE PROBLEM WITH THE CLU LEFT JOINT
  mutate(clu = str_remove_all(clu, " ")) %>%
  # Add mean estimates
  left_join(rename(dat_plot, estimate_mean = estimate__), by = join_by(mod, reg, pat, imm_name, pi_vac_week_v1, clu)) %>%
  group_by(pat, imm_name, clu) %>%
  mutate(estimate_mean_norm = estimate_mean/mean(estimate_mean, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(pat, mod, reg, clu, imm_name, sample__) %>%
  filter(!(pat == "multi_dtpa" & mod == "bmvl_s08_multi_dtpa_csi_reg_4_gauss.rds" & 
             reg == "reg_4_gauss" & clu == "4_Temperate south" & imm_name == "tetan" & 
             sample__ %in% c("51_4_Temperate south", "58_4_Temperate south", "65_4_Temperate south",
                             "68_4_Temperate south", "69_4_Temperate south",
                             "70_4_Temperate south"))) %>%
  mutate(phi_emp = which(est_norm == max(est_norm, na.rm = TRUE)),
         est_norm_max = max(est_norm, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(imm_name = replace_na(imm_name, ""), 
         sam_imm = paste0(sample__, "_", pat, imm_name), 
         pat_tidy = case_when(pat %in% c("multi_mmr", "multi_dtpa", "multi_dtpw", "multi_mmr-vzv") ~ imm_name,
                              .default = ""),
         imm_tidy = case_when(pat %in% c("multi_men", "multi_ipv", "multi_pertu") ~ imm_name,
                              .default = NA)) %>%
  left_join(rename(pat_tidy_names, pat_tidy_name = pat_tidy)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mod)) %>%
  filter(!(pat == "hav" & clu == "3_Tropical"))

```

```{r}
library(viridis)

clu_l <- unique(filter(dat_plspa, reg == "reg_6")$clu)
dat_plspa_l <- list()

dat_plspa_l$temperate <- dat_plspa %>%
  filter(reg == "reg_6") %>%
  filter(clu == clu_l[[1]]) %>%
  mutate(pat_imm = str_remove_all(as.character(pat_imm), "_NA"),
         pat_sin = case_when(
           pat_imm %in% c("hav", "hbv", "hib", "rota", "strep") ~ pat_imm,
           pat_imm %in% c("men", "multi_men_mena", "multi_men_menc") ~ "men",
           pat_imm %in% c("measl", "multi_mmr_measl", "multi_mmr-vzv_measl") ~ "measl",
           pat_imm %in% c("mumps", "multi_mmr_mumps", "multi_mmr-vzv_mumps") ~ "mumps",
           pat_imm %in% c("rubel", "multi_mmr_rubel", "multi_mmr-vzv_rubel") ~ "rubel",
           pat_imm %in% c("vzv", "multi_mmr-vzv_vzv") ~ "vzv",
           pat_imm %in% c("dtpa", "dtpw", "multi_dtpa_dipht") ~ "dipht",
           pat_imm %in% c("pertu", "pertufha", "pertuprn", "multi_dtpa_pertupt", "multi_pertu_pertupt",
                          "multi_pertu_pertufha", "multi_pertu_pertuprn") ~ "pertu",
           pat_imm %in% c("tetan", "multi_dtpa_tetan") ~ "tetan",
           pat_imm %in% c("ipv", "ipv1", "ipv2", "ipv3", "multi_ipv_polio3", "multi_ipv_polio1", 
                      "multi_ipv_polio2") ~ "polio")) %>%
  filter(!(pat %in% c("hbv", "opv", "dtpw", "multi_dtpw")))

bind_rows(dat_plspa_l$temperate) %>%
  distinct(pat_sin, pat_imm, phi, clu, vac_week_v1, lower__, upper__) %>%
  group_by(pat_sin, pat_imm, phi, clu) %>%
  filter(vac_week_v1 == round(phi)) %>%
  group_by(pat_sin) %>%
  mutate(median_phi = median(phi)) %>%
  filter(!(pat_imm %in% c("multi_mmr-vzv_measl", "multi_mmr-vzv_mumps",
                          "multi_mmr-vzv_rubel", "multi_mmr-vzv_vzv", 
                          "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "multi_ipv_polio3", "multi_ipv_polio2",
                          "multi_ipv_polio1"))) %>%
  mutate(phi = sprintf("%02d", round(phi)),
         phi = as.Date(paste(2024, phi, 1, sep = "-"), format = "%Y-%U-%u")) %>%
  left_join(pat_tidy_names, join_by("pat_sin" == "pat")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = pat_tidy, x = phi, color = phi)) + 
  geom_point(size = 2) + 
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = phi - 10, xmax = phi + 10) ) + 
  scale_y_discrete("") + 
  scale_x_date("Peak timing", date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%B", expand = c(0,0)) + 
  scale_color_gradientn("Peak timing", colors = c(viridis(6, begin = 0, option = "D"),
                                               rev(viridis(7, begin = 0, option = "D")))) +
  coord_radial(inner.radius = 0.3, r_axis_inside = TRUE, start = 0, end = 1.65*pi) + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

```{r}
dat_plspa_all <- dat_plspa %>%
  filter(reg == "reg_6") %>%
  filter((pat %in% c("rota", "hav", "hbv", "dtpa", "tetan", "pertu", "ipv",
                     "hib", "men", "strep", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "vzv"))) %>%
  left_join(pat_tidy_names) %>%
  distinct(pat, phi_emp, sample__, clu, est_norm_max) %>%
  left_join(pat_tidy_names) %>%
  group_by(pat, pat_tidy, clu) %>%
  mutate(
    median_amp = median(est_norm_max),
    amp_min = quantile(est_norm_max, prob = 0.25),
    amp_max = quantile(est_norm_max, prob = 0.75),
    median_phi = median(phi_emp),
    phi_min = quantile(phi_emp, prob = 0.25),
    phi_max = quantile(phi_emp, prob = 0.75),
    phi_min = sprintf("%02d", round(phi_min)),
    phi_max = sprintf("%02d", round(phi_max)),
    median_phi = sprintf("%02d", round(median_phi)),
    median_phi_week = as.Date(paste(2024, median_phi, 1, sep = "-"), format = "%Y-%U-%u"),
    phi_min_week = as.Date(paste(2024, phi_min, 1, sep = "-"), format = "%Y-%U-%u"), 
    phi_max_week = as.Date(paste(2024, phi_max, 1, sep = "-"), format = "%Y-%U-%u")) %>%
  distinct(pat, pat_tidy, median_phi, median_phi_week, phi_min, phi_max, phi_min_week, phi_max_week, 
           clu, median_amp, amp_min, amp_max) %>%
  mutate(clu = factor(clu, levels = c("1_Temperate", "2_Subtropical", "3_Tropical", "6_Temperatesouth",
                                      "5_Subtropicalsouth", "4_Tropicalsouth")))

dat_plspa_all %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = reorder(pat_tidy, median_phi_week), x = median_phi_week, color = as.numeric(median_phi))) + 
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 1) +

  scale_y_discrete("") + 
  scale_x_date("Peak timing", date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%B") + 
    scale_color_gradientn("Peak timing", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(1,52),
                          colours = c(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "C"),
                                      rev(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "C")))) +

  theme_minimal() + 
  facet_wrap(~clu, ncol = 2, dir = "v") + 
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

# Per pathogen, per region plots 
```{r}
dat_plspa_perpatclu <- filter(dat_plspa, reg == "reg_6") %>%
  filter(!(pat %in% c("hbv", "opv", "dtpw", "multi_dtpw", "ipv3", "ipv2", "pertuprn", "pertufha"))) %>%
  distinct(pat, clu) %>%
  filter(!(pat == "hav" & clu == "2_Tropical")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(clu))

pl_l <- list()
for (i in seq_len(length(dat_plspa_perpatclu$pat))) {  
  dati <- dat_plspa %>%
    filter(reg == "reg_6",
           clu == dat_plspa_perpatclu$clu[i],
           pat == dat_plspa_perpatclu$pat[i]) %>%
    filter(!(pat %in% c("hbv", "opv", "dtpw", "multi_dtpw", "ipv3", "ipv2", "pertuprn", "pertufha"))) %>%
    group_by(pat, pat_tidy, clu) %>%
    mutate(median_phi = median(phi_emp),
           pat_clu = paste0(pat_tidy_name, ", Region: ", str_remove_all(clu, "_|1|2|3|4|5|6"))) 
  if(all(is.na(dati$vac_week_v1)) == FALSE) {
  pl_l[[i]] <- ggplot(dati, aes(x = vac_week_v1, y = est_norm - 1, group = sam_imm, color = median_phi)) + 
      geom_line(alpha = 0.2) + 
      geom_line(aes(y = estimate_mean_norm - 1, group = imm_tidy), size = 1) +
      scale_x_continuous("Week of vaccination", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(1,52)) + 
      scale_y_continuous("Conditional effect") + 
      scale_color_gradientn("Peak timing",
                            breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(1,52),
                            colours = c(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "C"),
                                      rev(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "C"))),
                            guide = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top",
                                                   title.hjust = 0.5,
                                                   barheight = 0.8)) +
    geom_point(aes(y = -Inf), shape = "|", size = 3) +
    facet_wrap(~pat_clu) + 
    theme(legend.position = "top")
  
  ggsave(pl_l[[i]], width = 5, height = 5,
         file = glue("../figures/perpatclu/ce_reg_4_{dat_plspa_perpatclu$pat[i]}_{dat_plspa_perpatclu$clu[i]}.pdf"))
  }
}
```

# Read models and extracting coefficients for base models
```{r}
df_fixed <- sapply(coef_l, function(x) {
  x$fixed %>%
    rownames_to_column("parameter") %>%
    filter(str_detect(parameter, "age|sex|vac_conc|time_v1_v2|time_v2_v3|time_vl_s1"))}, 
  simplify = FALSE) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "mod") %>%
  # Attach pathogen and reg 
  left_join(select(df_converged, -Rhat_cond), by = join_by(mod)) %>%
  # Extract the imm_name and clu from the parameter name
  mutate(imm_name = str_extract(parameter, "(?<=immvals1anti)[^_]+"),
         parameter = case_when(!is.na(imm_name) ~ str_remove_all(parameter, imm_name),
                               .default = parameter),
         parameter = str_remove_all(parameter, "immvals1anti_")) 
  
df_fixed %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Estimate, y = imm_name, color = reg)) + 
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0), color = "grey", linetype = "dotted") + 
    geom_point() + 
    geom_segment(aes(x = `l-95% CI`, xend = `u-95% CI`, yend = imm_name)) + 
  facet_grid(pat+imm_name~parameter, scales = "free", switch = "y") + 
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), 
        axis.line.y = element_blank(),
        strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0))
```

# Checking the correlation matrices ================================================================
```{r}
library(corrplot)
library("ggcorrplot")

df_converged_multi <- df_converged %>%
  filter(str_detect(reg, "base") & str_detect(pathogen, "multi")) %>%
  filter(!(pathogen %in% c("multi_dtp", "multi_polio")))

# Obtain the correlation matrix from the base models
corrmatrix_l <- sapply(1:length(df_converged_multi[[1]]), function(x) {
  pat <- df_converged_multi[x, 'pathogen']
  name_reg <- df_converged_multi[x, "reg"]
  # Obtain conditional effects   
  pomp::bake(file = glue("{dirs$outputs}/modres_coef/corrmatrix_{pat}_{name_reg}.rds"), {
    # Read model
    mod <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/perpathogen/{pat}/bm{vac_l[[pat]]}_s08_{pat}_{name_reg}.rds"))
    # Obtain correlation matrix
    corrmatrix <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(mod)$residual__$cor) %>%
      select(starts_with("Estimate"))
    return(corrmatrix)
  })
}, simplify = FALSE)
names(corrmatrix_l) <- df_converged_multi$pathogen

corrmatrix_pl <- lapply(1:length(corrmatrix_l), function(x) {
  names(corrmatrix_l[[x]]) <- str_remove(names(corrmatrix_l[[x]]), "Estimate.immvals1anti")
  rownames(corrmatrix_l[[x]]) <- str_remove(rownames(corrmatrix_l[[x]]), "immvals1anti")
  ggcorrplot(corrmatrix_l[[x]], hc.order = TRUE, lab = TRUE) +
    theme(legend.position = "none") + 
      ggtitle(names(corrmatrix_l)[[x]])})
wrap_plots(corrmatrix_pl)
```
